title: Qualifications: choose the structure
question: Same content, new look, the goal first. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Goal band, live board
options.thesis: The band carries the goal (29 of 70, a bar built from each opener's share). The submissions become a navy board of qualifications, newest first, with a stage word per row. Openers sit in a rail beside it, and pressing one filters the board.
options.viewport: Navy band: Qualifications; range, Live and day line; picker, Schedules and Export. Under the title, the goal row: 30px condensed '29 of 70', '41%', a 14px bar in opener segments, '70 a day × 1 business day', Edit goal. Below: left, the qualifications board (TIME, LEAD, OPENER, PROGRAM, STAGE); right, a 360px Openers rail (count, per hour, last event).
options.risk: A month's range is hundreds of rows on navy, and the board was drawn for one day. The ranking moves to a rail, so long names truncate.

raised.raise: On Today, rows rerank in place: a new qualification moves its opener up and holds a highlight until the next update.

options.label: Opener tiles
options.lineage: One tile per opener, under the goal
options.thesis: The band carries the goal and its bar. Each opener with a qualification gets a tile (count, per hour, last event, share of the goal). Scheduled openers with none yet fold into one quiet tile. A tile is a filter for the Submissions card below.
options.viewport: The same navy band with the goal row. Under it, a four-across grid of opener tiles (avatar, name, 30px count, '1.7 /h', 'Last 4:44 PM', a share bar), then one tile naming the seven openers with none yet. Below, the Submissions card: search, stage select, ruled rows that open in place.
options.risk: Equal tiles give the eye no order beyond reading position, and twelve or more openers on a month's range run to three rows.

options.label: Goal beside the ranking
options.lineage: A goal panel and a ranking table
options.thesis: A navy goal panel (the book panel's sibling) sits beside the openers table, so on goal and who got us there read in one row. Submissions follow full width as a ruled list. The four Operations pages can share this arrangement.
options.viewport: Navy band: Qualifications, range and Live line, picker, Schedules, Export. Row: left, a 1fr navy Goal panel ('29' at 30px condensed, 'of 70 · 41%', a 14px bar in opener segments, '70 a day × 1 business day', Edit goal); right, a 2fr Openers table (OPENER, QUALIFIED with an inline bar, PER HOUR, LAST EVENT) whose zero rows fold into one line. Below, the Submissions card.
options.risk: The most familiar of the three, with two navy surfaces stacked at the top, so the goal panel has to earn its weight beside the band.
